Overview

Vijayawada is a city in Andhra Pradesh with a population of 1,500,000. A major commercial and cultural center in Andhra Pradesh, known for the Prakasam Barrage, Kanaka Durga Temple, and spicy cuisine. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
